name: ThreeEMA
summary: This EA implements a triple Exponential Moving Average (EMA) crossover trend-following strategy using the MQL5 Standard Library framework. It generates trade signals based on the alignment of fast (5), medium (12), and slow (24) period EMAs, with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and uses fixed lot sizing for money management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MQL5标准库框架实现了三重指数移动平均线(EMA)交叉趋势跟踪策略。通过快速(5)、中速(12)和慢速(24)周期EMA的排列方向生成交易信号，采用固定止损止盈和固定手数进行资金管理。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用三条不同周期的EMA来判断趋势方向和入场时机。当快速EMA位于中速EMA之上、中速EMA位于慢速EMA之上时，视为上升趋势并做多；反之则做空。入场条件基于三线排列顺序的变化，即趋势形成或反转时开仓。出场条件采用固定点数的止损(400点)和止盈(900点)，止盈是止损的2.25倍，具有正的盈亏比。仓位管理采用固定手数模式(CMoneyFixedLot)，默认手数为0.1手，不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理方面设定了10%的风险百分比参数，但由于使用固定手数，该参数实际作用于保证金计算而非动态仓位调整。策略未使用追踪止损(CTrailingNone)，完全依赖固定止盈止损出场。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is using three EMAs of different periods to determine trend direction and entry timing. When the fast EMA is above the medium EMA and the medium EMA is above the slow EMA, it identifies an uptrend and goes long; the opposite alignment signals a short entry. Entry conditions are based on the alignment order of the three lines, opening positions when a trend forms or reverses. Exit conditions use fixed point-based stop-loss (400 points) and take-profit (900 points), yielding a reward-to-risk ratio of 2.25:1 which is favorable. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default of 0.1 lots, not dynamically adjusting based on account balance. Money management sets a 10% risk percentage parameter, but since fixed lots are used, this parameter affects margin calculation rather than dynamic position sizing. The strategy does not use trailing stops (CTrailingNone), relying entirely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit for exits.

parameters.name: Inp_Money_FixLot_Percent
parameters.description: 固定手数资金管理风险百分比
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot money management risk percentage

pros: 使用MQL5标准库框架，代码结构清晰规范，模块化程度高，信号、追踪、资金管理分离
三EMA过滤机制相比双EMA能更有效减少假信号，趋势确认更可靠
止盈止损比达到2.25:1，具备正期望值的基础盈亏比优势
pros_en: Uses MQL5 Standard Library framework with clean, modular architecture separating signal, trailing, and money management components
Triple EMA filtering reduces false signals more effectively than dual EMA crossovers, providing more reliable trend confirmation
Take-profit to stop-loss ratio of 2.25:1 provides a positive expectancy foundation with favorable reward-to-risk
cons: 未使用追踪止损，趋势行情中无法锁定浮动利润，可能过早止盈而错失大段行情
固定手数不根据账户规模和波动率动态调整，无法实现真正的风险比例控制
EMA策略在震荡行情中会产生频繁的假突破信号导致连续亏损，缺乏震荡过滤机制
cons_en: No trailing stop means the EA cannot lock in floating profits during strong trends, potentially exiting too early via fixed take-profit and missing extended moves
Fixed lot sizing does not dynamically adjust based on account size or volatility, preventing true proportional risk control
EMA crossover strategies generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses, with no range/filter mechanism included
improvements: 添加追踪止损模块替代CTrailingNone，在趋势行情中动态锁定利润，提高单笔盈利上限
增加震荡行情过滤器（如ADX或ATR），在低趋势强度时暂停交易，减少假信号造成的亏损
improvements_en: Add a trailing stop module to replace CTrailingNone, dynamically locking in profits during trending markets and increasing maximum profit per trade
Add a range market filter (such as ADX or ATR-based volatility check) to pause trading during low trend strength periods, reducing losses from false signals

risk_points: EMA策略在震荡市中会产生频繁的反复开仓平仓信号，可能导致连续小额亏损累积
固定止损400点在极端行情下可能不够，且未考虑不同品种的波动率差异
risk_points_en: EMA strategies generate frequent whipsaw signals in ranging markets, potentially accumulating consecutive small losses
Fixed 400-point stop-loss may be insufficient during extreme market conditions and does not account for volatility differences across instruments
